levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Sorts fewer than half of the eight cards into the correct pile.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Sorts all eight cards into the correct raw or ready-to-eat pile.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Sorts all eight cards correctly and also sorts the three new named foods correctly in the independent task.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Sorts by an unrelated feature, like food type or color, instead of raw versus ready-to-eat.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Gives a reason grounded in whether the food is safe to eat right now for at least three cards.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Gives a grounded reason for every card and correctly handles a same-food exception, such as raw egg versus cooked egg, if it comes up.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cannot explain why raw and ready-to-eat foods should not share a cutting board or plate.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Explains that raw and ready-to-eat foods should not touch or share a surface.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Explains the touching-and-surface rule and adds washing hands after touching raw food.

lookFors: The learner uses 'raw' and 'ready-to-eat' vocabulary rather than vague terms like 'gross' or 'clean.'
The reflection response names a specific real scenario, like dripping juices or a reused plate, not a vague answer.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
